# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `jerry` MCP server pointing at Jerry's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.jerry.ai/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and Jerry sign-in — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: Jerry's official mark, from the 512×512 app icon on jerry.ai, resized to 192×192.
